newsitem.title: POLAND: SWARZEDZ SAYS IN TALKS WITH INVESTORS.
newsitem.headline: SWARZEDZ SAYS IN TALKS WITH INVESTORS.

text.p: Polish furniture maker Swarzedz SA is in talks with investors to acquire a stake in the company by taking a part of the issue planned for the third quarter of the year, the firm's president said on Tuesday.

Julian Nuckowski told Reuters one of the investors was Germany's International Moebelhandelskantor Gmbh & Co KH (IMK), a part of Schieder Group, with which it had a trade agreement, but said no decisions had been taken yet.
"We are negotiating with different firms, including our (trade) partners, including Schieder, but no decisions had been taken yet," he said.
Late last year Swarzedz signed a contract on producing furniture worth 200 million marks until 2002 for IMK, which also provided for a possibility of acquiring about five percent of Swarzedz by IMK.
According to the agreement the stake could be expanded and taken by other firms of the Schieder Group.
Swarzedz plans to issue the 3.125 million shares to creditors in the third quarter and to offer another 3.5 million shares in a one-for-one rights issue.
Nuckowski said the prospective investor would take the shares if current shareholders did not exercise their rights.
